# Pizza dough

For two trays. Tags in the text stay tags: #baking

- [x] 500 g flour
- [ ] 7 g yeast
- ~~sugar~~ no sugar

![A dot](../../attachments/6b/6b7fa434f92a8b80aab02d9bf1a12e49ffcae424e4013a1c4f68b67e3d2bbcd0.png)

Rest *at least* two hours.  
Overnight is better.
